capabilities: Start and manage a shared local DevMate runtime from Obsidian
Share the vault with MCP clients as read-only or read-write
Expose note search, properties, graph and file operations to models
Notify when agents or clients await approval and open the workbench to answer
disambiguation: Not a coding assistant inside Obsidian; the plugin only shares the vault and its note tools with external AI clients through a local runtime.
extras: Desktop only; the runtime keeps running after Obsidian closes until stopped; state and credentials live in ~/.devmate/runtime outside the vault; no telemetry, account or payment; macOS and Linux untested; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way for cloud AI chat clients to work directly on vault notes through the Model Context Protocol.

relations.evidence: The main use is connecting the chat window you already use (ChatGPT on the web, Claude) to your machine
For ChatGPT on the web or Claude.ai, run DevMate: Configure Connection once
devmate client add claude-code (or by hand: claude mcp add --scope user --transport http devmate
Compiler, type and lint errors come straight from VS Code, without running a build

requires.name: ChatGPT or Claude account for cloud clients

summary: Local MCP gateway plugin that shares the vault with AI chat clients such as ChatGPT and Claude for reading, searching and editing notes.
